race:felkin.title: Felkin
race:felkin.summary: Cat-folk of the dunes and rooftops: quick, curious, proud and very good at landing on their feet. Felkin say they have nine lives, and spend them accordingly.

sections.title: Who they are
sections.text: Felkin are lean, furred and graceful, with tails that give away every feeling they try to hide. They live about sixty years, nap whenever possible, and follow their curiosity wherever it leads, which is usually somewhere they were told not to go. They are loyal to their village, generous to their friends and dreadful at keeping still.

sections.title: Where they live
sections.text: In the south, around the [[place:endless-dunes|Endless Dunes]]. The [[culture:felkin.sandstride|Sandstriders]] cross the dunes in caravans, the [[culture:felkin.moonclaw|Moonclaw]] hunt the high roofs of [[place:saffra|Saffra]], and the [[culture:felkin.hearthpaw|Hearthpaw]] keep the villages and their fires.

sections.title: Nine lives
sections.text: Every felkin child is told they have nine lives. The [[faith:sun-temple|Sun Temple]] teaches it, the grandparents prove it with stories, and the felkin gift of surviving what should kill them does nothing to disprove it. The real worry, felkin say, is never knowing which life is the last.

sections.title: Among the Pact
sections.text: Pell Quickwhisker of the [[era:first-five|First Five]] stole the heart of the [[hollow:cinder-gate|Cinder Gate]] out of its guardian's chest. Felkin have been joining the [[faction:pact|Pact]] ever since, mostly out of curiosity, and staying for the treasure.

facts: About 60 years, or nine of them
The Endless Dunes, Saffra, the southern villages
Nine Lives: once per battle, survive a killing blow with 1 health
quote: Curiosity has killed me four times. I am still curious.

heritage:felkin.title: Felkin Heritage
heritage:felkin.summary: Felkin heritage is purred: told in warm piles at night, each tale a little taller in every telling. Renown is how tall your tale has grown, and kin who were there make it grow faster.

sections.title: Taller in the telling
sections.text: Felkin do not write their histories. They tell them, curled up together, and every telling adds a little. A felkin's Renown is how much their tale has grown. Felkin who fight beside each other have more witnesses to exaggerate for them, which they consider the purpose of friendship.

heritage:felkin.trunk0.title: Light Paws
heritage:felkin.trunk0.summary: Felkin walk so softly that sand-wyrms do not notice them, and neither do most guards.

heritage:felkin.trunk1.title: Whiskers
heritage:felkin.trunk1.summary: Felkin whiskers feel the air move before a blow lands, which is how they dodge what they never saw.

heritage:felkin.trunk2.title: Sagas
heritage:felkin.trunk2.summary: The tales purred in warm piles, taller every night. Each deed added brings more Renown.

heritage:felkin.sandstride0.title: Dune Runner
heritage:felkin.sandstride0.summary: The endless stride of the Sandstriders, who run the dunes from oasis to oasis.

heritage:felkin.sandstride1.title: Oasis
heritage:felkin.sandstride1.summary: The secret springs of the desert, which the Sandstriders keep and which keep them.

heritage:felkin.sandstride2.title: Sandstriders Kinship
heritage:felkin.sandstride2.summary: A caravan moves together or dies alone. Sandstriders in one band move as one.

heritage:felkin.moonclaw0.title: Sharp Claws
heritage:felkin.moonclaw0.summary: The claws of the Moonclaw hunters, kept sharp on the stone of Saffra's roofs.

heritage:felkin.moonclaw1.title: Night Eyes
heritage:felkin.moonclaw1.summary: Moonclaw eyes see in the dark as well as by day, and see weak spots best of all.

heritage:felkin.moonclaw2.title: Moonclaw Kinship
heritage:felkin.moonclaw2.summary: Moonclaw prides share every kill. Two in a band hunt the same prey from two sides.

heritage:felkin.hearthpaw0.title: Warm Paws
heritage:felkin.hearthpaw0.summary: The healing warmth of the Hearthpaw, who mend by touch and by purring.

heritage:felkin.hearthpaw1.title: Curl Up
heritage:felkin.hearthpaw1.summary: Hearthpaw felkin know when to curl up and let a blow pass over them.

heritage:felkin.hearthpaw2.title: Hearthpaw Kinship
heritage:felkin.hearthpaw2.summary: The village keeps its fire together. Hearthpaw kin keep each other warm in any dark.

culture:felkin.sandstride.title: Sandstriders
culture:felkin.sandstride.summary: The caravan felkin of the Endless Dunes, who cross the sand by the stars, keep the hidden springs secret and never stay in one place long.

sections.title: The dunes
sections.text: Only the Sandstriders know the way across the [[place:endless-dunes|Endless Dunes]], and they keep it that way. Their caravans carry spice, salt and news between [[place:saffra|Saffra]] and the far south, guided by the stars and by oases marked on no map.

sections.title: The people
sections.text: Sandstriders are nomads, messengers and traders. They are tough, light-footed and very hard to cheat. A Sandstrider tent never stays in one place more than a season, and a Sandstrider child knows every star by name before they can count.

sections.title: The oases
sections.text: The hidden springs of the desert are kept by Oasis Keepers, families sworn to their secret. A Sandstrider would sooner die of thirst than give away an oasis, and some have.

facts: A tail curled around the other's wrist
quote: The stars do not move. The sand does. Trust the stars.

culture:felkin.moonclaw.title: Moonclaw
culture:felkin.moonclaw.kicker: Night hunters of the high roofs
culture:felkin.moonclaw.summary: The felkin who rule the rooftops of Saffra by night: hunters, thieves and acrobats who share every kill and never touch the ground if they can help it.

sections.title: The roofs
sections.text: Above the streets of [[place:saffra|Saffra]] runs a second city of rooftops, bridges and hidden gardens, and the Moonclaw own it. Their prides hunt beasts for the night market, run errands no one else can, and occasionally steal the moon's silver from the Sultan's domes.

sections.title: The people
sections.text: Moonclaw felkin are hunters, thieves and acrobats. They value daring, skill and sharing: a pride shares every kill, and a Moonclaw who keeps something back is no longer Moonclaw. Many end up in the [[faction:quiet-hand|Quiet Hand]], which considers them its finest recruits.

sections.title: The ghost-cat
sections.text: The roofs have a legend: a ghost-cat that hunts the highest domes on moonless nights. Tracking it and coming back is the greatest deed a young Moonclaw can claim.

quote: Never touch the ground. Never keep the kill.

culture:felkin.hearthpaw.title: Hearthpaw
culture:felkin.hearthpaw.kicker: Village healers and keepers of the fire
culture:felkin.hearthpaw.summary: The village felkin of the south: healers, herbalists and hearth-tenders who keep the fire burning, the kits fed and the whole village in each other's business.

sections.title: The villages
sections.text: Hearthpaw villages sit on the edge of the dunes, built around a great fire that is never allowed to go out. Window boxes of herbs grow on every sill, and a night watch walks the roofs against the [[faction:chain-lords|Chain Lords]].

sections.title: The people
sections.text: Hearthpaw felkin are healers, cooks, herbalists and gossips. They mend with herbs, warm paws and purring, which works better than it should. Everyone in a Hearthpaw village knows everyone, which is lovely, and everyone knows everything, which is less so.

sections.title: The sand plague
sections.text: When the sand plague comes out of the deep desert, the Hearthpaw healers walk out to meet it. Nursing a village through the plague is the greatest deed a Hearthpaw can do.

quote: Keep the fire, and the fire keeps you.

backstory:felkin.dunerunner.title: Dune Runner
backstory:felkin.dunerunner.summary: Carried messages across the Endless Dunes faster than any camel, and knows every shortcut the sand allows.

sections.title: Runners
sections.text: Sandstrider runners carry news between caravans and oases. They travel light, sleep little and know the dunes as well as their own tail.

backstory:felkin.oasiskeeper.title: Oasis Keeper
backstory:felkin.oasiskeeper.summary: Kept one of the hidden springs where the caravans drink, and never told anyone where it is.

sections.title: Keepers
sections.text: Oasis Keepers are sworn to their spring. The caravans trust them with their lives, because without them nobody crosses the [[place:endless-dunes|dunes]].

backstory:felkin.nomad.title: Caravan Child
backstory:felkin.nomad.summary: Born under a Sandstrider tent that never stayed in one place, and raised by the whole caravan.

sections.title: Caravan children
sections.text: Sandstrider kits ride on camels before they can walk and learn the stars before they can read. They are at home everywhere, and nowhere in particular.

backstory:felkin.rooftop.title: Rooftop Thief
backstory:felkin.rooftop.summary: Learned the high roofs of Saffra by stealing the moon's silver from the Sultan's domes.

sections.title: The moon's silver
sections.text: The domes of [[place:saffra|Saffra]] are tiled in silver that catches the moonlight. Stealing a tile is a rite of passage for young Moonclaw, and the Sultan has given up replacing them.

backstory:felkin.nighthunter.title: Night Hunter
backstory:felkin.nighthunter.summary: Hunted beasts by moonlight for the night market of Saffra.

sections.title: The night market
sections.text: Saffra's night market sells what was caught that night: desert hares, giant beetles, the occasional scorpion. Moonclaw hunters supply most of it.

backstory:felkin.clawsworn.title: Clawsworn
backstory:felkin.clawsworn.summary: Sworn to a Moonclaw pride of hunters that shares every kill.

sections.title: The pride
sections.text: A Moonclaw pride is closer than family. Its members swear on their claws to share every kill and never leave one of their own on the roofs.

backstory:felkin.hearthtender.title: Hearth Tender
backstory:felkin.hearthtender.summary: Kept the village fire burning through every storm, and knows exactly how much wood a night takes.

sections.title: The fire
sections.text: Every Hearthpaw village fire has burned since the village was founded. Its tenders take shifts, and a tender who lets it go out is never allowed to forget it.

backstory:felkin.healerpaw.title: Healer's Ward
backstory:felkin.healerpaw.summary: Raised by the village healer, fetching herbs and bandages and learning by watching.

sections.title: Healers' wards
sections.text: Hearthpaw healers take in orphaned kits as wards. Most become healers themselves, and all of them can bandage a wound in the dark.

backstory:felkin.villageborn.title: Village Heart
backstory:felkin.villageborn.summary: Everyone in the village knows their name and their mischief, and would fight anyone who hurt them.

sections.title: The heart of it
sections.text: Every Hearthpaw village has one: the kit everyone watched grow up, scolded, fed and adored. Leaving is hard. Coming back is a festival.

answer:felkin.grandparents.0.summary: The Sultan's sapphire has been stolen four times and returned three. Every felkin family claims an ancestor was involved.

answer:felkin.grandparents.1.summary: Caravan masters of the Sandstriders count their crossings of the Endless Dunes like other peoples count battles.

answer:felkin.grandparents.2.summary: The sacred cats of the Sun Temple are guarded day and night. They are entirely unimpressed by this.

answer:felkin.grandparents.3.summary: Felkin who use up eight lives are honoured as elders, and watched very closely by their families.

answer:felkin.parents.0.summary: Saffra's spice market is the largest in the world. Felkin who grow up in it can name a spice by its sneeze.

answer:felkin.parents.1.summary: Felkin night watches walk the village roofs with glowing eyes, watching for the Chain Lords.

answer:felkin.parents.2.summary: Hearthpaw herbalists grow their gardens on every windowsill, and every village smells of mint and sage.

answer:felkin.parents.3.summary: Felkin acrobat troupes tour the human towns, and are the only felkin many humans ever see.

answer:felkin.siblings.0.summary: Felkin litters sleep in a pile until they are grown, and many never quite stop.

answer:felkin.siblings.1.summary: Runts of the litter learn to be quick, and the quickest felkin are usually runts.

answer:felkin.siblings.2.summary: The Moonclaw recruit from every village, and their recruits rarely write home. They are busy on the roofs.

answer:felkin.siblings.3.summary: Single kits are rare among felkin, and spoiled accordingly.

answer:felkin.birth.0.summary: The Moonclaw say a felkin born under a full moon is a hunter born. They also say it about everyone they like.

answer:felkin.birth.1.summary: Sandstorms bury camps whole. A kit born in one is said to belong to the dunes forever.

answer:felkin.birth.2.summary: The nine stars of the Sandstriders' sky are said to guard felkin lives. When they align, the priestesses argue for days.

answer:felkin.birth.3.summary: Felkin neighbours are competitive about kits. Stealing one for a day is a scandal, not a crime.

answer:felkin.friend.0.summary: Fennec foxes live on the dune edges and are the felkins' favourite pets, despite the ears.

answer:felkin.friend.1.summary: Sand-lizards love warm heads. Felkin heads are very warm.

answer:felkin.friend.2.summary: The healer's family is the heart of a Hearthpaw village, and their kits know everyone's scrapes.

answer:felkin.friend.3.summary: Human traders bring their families to Saffra's markets, where their children try, and fail, to keep up on the roofs.

answer:felkin.play.0.summary: Rooftop chases are how every Saffra kit learns the second city above the streets.

answer:felkin.play.1.summary: The Sun Temple teaches that every warm spot is blessed. Felkin take this very seriously.

answer:felkin.play.2.summary: Every felkin keeps a box of shinies. Saffra's silver domes are a constant temptation.

answer:felkin.play.3.summary: Hunting games are how the Moonclaw find their next hunters.

answer:felkin.teen.0.summary: Saffra's bazaar is full of young pickpockets. The Quiet Hand keeps an eye on the best of them.

answer:felkin.teen.1.summary: Young felkin who run with the caravans learn the stars, the springs and how to go without water.

answer:felkin.teen.2.summary: The village hearth is where Hearthpaw healers teach, and where most of the village's gossip begins.

answer:felkin.teen.3.summary: Moon-dancers perform at the Sun Temple on full moons, and have broken more young hearts than any thief.

answer:felkin.firstfight.0.summary: Desert scorpions grow huge near Hollows, where the warm ground feeds them.

answer:felkin.firstfight.1.summary: Thieves' gangs fight for turf on Saffra's roofs, and the Moonclaw settle the worst of it.

answer:felkin.firstfight.2.summary: The Chain Lords raid felkin villages for captives. Standing over the kits is what every felkin fears they will one day have to do.

answer:felkin.firstfight.3.summary: Felkin consider a fast exit after a good pounce to be excellent tactics. Other peoples call it running.

answer:felkin.mentor.0.summary: Retired cat-burglars of Saffra take one apprentice each, and teach silence above all.

answer:felkin.mentor.1.summary: Sand-priestesses read the future in the dunes, and are right just often enough that nobody ignores them.

answer:felkin.mentor.2.summary: The village healer never hurries and never stops, and every Hearthpaw kit learns patience from them.

answer:felkin.mentor.3.summary: Caravan masters can smell a bad deal and a sandstorm a mile off, and teach both.

answer:felkin.leaving.0.summary: Curiosity is the felkin curse and gift. The Pact's Hollows are the most interesting places in the world.

answer:felkin.leaving.1.summary: Debts to caravan masters are debts of honour, and are paid in treasure or in years.

answer:felkin.leaving.2.summary: A dream that comes nine nights in a row is a calling, the sand-priestesses say, and must be followed.

answer:felkin.leaving.3.summary: When the elders suggest a long journey, a felkin goes. They usually come back, with better pranks.

answer:felkin.deed.0.summary: Village bells are sacred to the Hearthpaw. One stolen by a bandit lord is a call to every felkin nearby.

answer:felkin.deed.1.summary: Crossing the Endless Dunes alone is a feat few Sandstriders have done. Nine days is a record.

answer:felkin.deed.2.summary: The sand plague comes out of the deep desert every few decades. Its healers are the heroes of the south.

answer:felkin.deed.3.summary: The ghost-cat of the high roofs is Saffra's oldest legend. Few who track it come back, and none agree on what they saw.

answer:felkin.loss.0.summary: The Sun Temple's dome is the highest roof in Saffra, and has cost many young felkin a life.

answer:felkin.loss.1.summary: Desert fevers come with the hot winds. Strangers who nurse a felkin through one are owed a life-debt.

answer:felkin.loss.2.summary: Felkin pride makes them take duels they should walk away from. The grandmothers have a lot to say about it.

answer:felkin.loss.3.summary: A felkin with nine lives left spends them like coins. The Pact's healers have opinions about this.

answer:felkin.fear.0.summary: Felkin and deep water do not get along, which is the one fear nobody teases them for.

answer:felkin.fear.1.summary: The Chain Lords' cages are the felkin nightmare, and the Pact pays a bounty for every one broken.

answer:felkin.fear.2.summary: A long quiet life is the felkin idea of a slow death.

answer:felkin.fear.3.summary: Nobody knows which of their nine lives is the last. That is what makes felkin brave and what keeps them awake.

answer:felkin.keepsake.0.summary: Felkin kits wear a bell collar so their parents can find them. Most hide the bell as soon as they are old enough.

answer:felkin.keepsake.1.summary: A box of shinies is a felkin's diary: every trinket marks a story.

answer:felkin.keepsake.2.summary: A healer's herb pouch carries the smell of home, and enough to stop most bleeding.

answer:felkin.keepsake.3.summary: Moon-charms are blessed at the Sun Temple on full moons, and glow faintly ever after.

answer:felkin.drive.0.summary: The Pact has more adventures in a week than a village has in a year.

answer:felkin.drive.1.summary: Hollows are full of treasure, and the Common Chest gives every hero a fair chance at the shiniest.

answer:felkin.drive.2.summary: Since the Waking, Hollows have opened near the southern villages. Keeping the fire burning means closing them.

answer:felkin.drive.3.summary: Felkin curiosity has never been satisfied, and the Waking has given it a great deal more to wonder about.
